## Problem
desk-q's Costs page reads GitHub billing, Vercel usage, AWS Cost Explorer and Neon. It has no line for the Claude and Codex subscriptions that run every worker, which are usually the largest cost of a batch. desk already knows each login (subscriptions.md) and already prices each session at API-equivalent list prices (worker-cost.mjs, used by the handoff and levers reports), and Usage shows each login's weekly limit. But nothing puts the month's subscription spend, or the value of the work it bought, next to the other suppliers.

## Acceptance criteria
- AC1: Given a login in subscriptions.md with a plan and monthly fee recorded (entered by hand in /desk-setup costs, never guessed), when desk-q renders Costs, then it shows that fee as a monthly line per login, shared across the repos it runs.
- AC2: Given worker and interactive sessions this month, when Costs renders, then each repo's row also shows the API-equivalent value of its Claude and Codex use, labelled as list-price equivalent, not a bill.
- AC3: Given no fee is recorded for a login, when Costs renders, then its line says "fee not set: /desk-setup costs", and the API-equivalent figure still shows.

## Design
No UI.

## Out of scope
None.

## Verification
Record a fee for one login; `desk-q costs --plain` shows the fee line and each repo's list-price-equivalent use for the month.
